主要内容: GigOptix, Inc. (NYSE MKT: GIG) reported record third quarter fiscal 2012 financial results, with total revenue increasing 20% to $10.1 million from $8.4 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2011. The company also saw a 5% increase from $9.6 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2012. Non-GAAP net income for the quarter was $0.02 per diluted share, compared to a net loss of $0.03 per share in the same period of fiscal 2011. Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the quarter were $12.3 million. The company highlighted its growth in key areas, including its optics product line and RF/MMIC business, driven by increased market interest in its E-band offerings. GigOptix reported record third quarter fiscal 2012 financial results, highlighting its ongoing legal battle against former employees and Optomai, Inc. The company is actively prosecuting a lawsuit for misappropriation of confidential information and trade secrets, having gathered substantial evidence through forensic work. GigOptix is moving the case toward trial, with Dr. Katz expressing confidence in the evidence. Financially, the company noted progress in market penetration and customer adoption of new products, but warned of increased macroeconomic uncertainty and short lead times in high-speed optical communications markets. The company expects fourth-quarter revenue to be in line with the third quarter due to cautious outlook. GigOptix will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the results and business outlook.
